C-10.Name: Editor right-click context menu with Copy as HTML (replace WKWebView default)
C-10.Summary: User report: "не вижу в контекстном меню при ПКМ пункта с хтмл копи" — the Edit menu has Copy as HTML (C-3) but right-click in the WYSIWYG editor shows WKWebView's default menu, which cannot be extended from JS. Suppress the default menu (Muya already dispatches a 'contextmenu' eventCenter event that nothing subscribes to) and show the app's native context menu (same mt::window-popup-context-menu path as tabs/sidebar) with Copy, Copy as HTML, and Select All. Paste is deliberately omitted: WKWebView cannot synthesize a paste event carrying clipboardData, so the native-menu route cannot drive it; Cmd+V is unaffected.

Problem.Description: Copy as HTML is unreachable from the editor's right-click menu.
Problem.RootCause: WKWebView owns the default context menu and offers no extension API; the renderer never subscribed to Muya's contextmenu dispatch.
Problem.Evidence: src/muya/lib/eventHandler/clickEvent.js dispatches eventCenter 'contextmenu'; grep for subscribers across src/renderer/src → none. src-tauri m009 already implements the native popup used by contextMenu/tabs (validate + capture selection by id).

Goals.R-1: editor.vue subscribes to muya 'contextmenu' (WYSIWYG surface only; source mode keeps its existing full suppression) and preventDefaults the DOM event, then invokes mt::window-popup-context-menu with: Copy (id copy, enabled only when muya getCopyData().text is non-empty), Copy as HTML (id copyAsHtml, always enabled — the C-3 whole-document fallback applies), separator, Select All (id selectAll).
Goals.R-2: Dispatch: copy → native clipboard-manager writeText of the selection markdown; copyAsHtml → existing handleCopyAsHtml (bus copyAsHtmlRich path, C-3); selectAll → muya.selectAll().
Goals.R-3: Locales: contextMenu.editor.{copy,copyAsHtml,selectAll} added to all ten locale PAIRS — both the full json and the .min.json that the renderer actually loads at runtime for non-en locales.
Goals.R-4: Tests pin: menu spec (items, order, copy enabled only with a selection), copy dispatch (writeText with the selection text), selectAll dispatch, copyAsHtml dispatch reaching the C-3 path.

Constraints.Constraint: Reuse the C-3 clipboard path and muya getCopyData/selectAll; no new IPC.
Source-code mode (CodeMirror) keeps suppressing the menu entirely.
Paste is out of scope (documented limitation, not a regression of Cmd+V).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Right-click in the WYSIWYG editor shows the native menu; Copy as HTML copies the same payload as the Edit-menu item. Carve-out: where muya does not dispatch contextmenu (DOM selection outside span.ag-paragraph, e.g. ag-html-preview blocks) the WKWebView default menu remains.
Copy is disabled with no selection; Select All selects the document.
Renderer suites green; CUA live check on a fresh build passes.
